title.zh: 【纽约梅隆银行与城堡证券完成代币化美债三方回购交易】
title.en: 【纽约梅隆银行与城堡证券完成代币化美债三方回购交易】

current_state.zh: BNY and Citadel Securities completed the first tri-party repo transaction using a tokenized US Treasury as collateral on a major tri-party platform, settling in minutes instead of T+1, with BNY planning digital cash and tokenized deposit capabilities.
current_state.en: BNY and Citadel Securities completed the first tri-party repo transaction using a tokenized US Treasury as collateral on a major tri-party platform, settling in minutes instead of T+1, with BNY planning digital cash and tokenized deposit capabilities.
